Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s correct findings by substituting Chiang Hsiao-chang’s father (Chiang Ching-kuo) with her grandfather (Chiang Kai-shek), then concluded with the children of Chiang Kai-shek. This generational mix-up led to an incorrect synthesis and premature completion, instead of identifying the other child of Chiang Ching-kuo (Chiang Hsiao-wu).
